note: Maps a defect description in expected/manifest.json to the codes an auditor may emit for it. A list means any one of those codes satisfies the expectation. Codes were derived from a real crawl of the fixtures rather than guessed: for each planted defect, the codes that fire on its page and NOT on the deliberately-clean pages are the candidates. Entries were then pruned to codes that exist in crawlkit's catalog. Two defects currently have no code that fires in the default profile -- see README 'Known crawlkit gaps'.
